CREATE TEMP TABLE _vault_count_accounts AS SELECT count(*)+0 AS expected FROM main.accounts

CREATE TEMP TRIGGER _vault_accounts_INSERT
                    BEFORE INSERT ON main.accounts BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO _vault_before_accounts SELECT r.tenant, r.name, r.balance FROM main.accounts AS r WHERE r.tenant IS NEW.tenant AND r.name IS NEW.name AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_seen_accounts AS s WHERE s.tenant IS NEW.tenant AND s.name IS NEW.name);INSERT INTO _vault_seen_accounts SELECT NEW.tenant, NEW.name WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_seen_accounts AS s WHERE s.tenant IS NEW.tenant AND s.name IS NEW.name);
                        INSERT INTO _vault_before_accounts
                        SELECT r.tenant, r.name, r.balance
                        FROM main.accounts AS r
                        WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.accounts AS v
                            WHERE v.rowid=NEW.rowid AND v.tenant IS r.tenant AND v.name IS r.name) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_seen_accounts AS s WHERE s.tenant IS r.tenant AND s.name IS r.name)
                    ;
                        INSERT INTO _vault_seen_accounts
                        SELECT r.tenant, r.name
                        FROM main.accounts AS r
                        WHERE r.rowid=NEW.rowid AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_seen_accounts AS s WHERE s.tenant IS r.tenant AND s.name IS r.name)
                    ;
                    END

CREATE TEMP TRIGGER _vault_accounts_UPDATE
                    BEFORE UPDATE ON main.accounts BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO _vault_before_accounts SELECT r.tenant, r.name, r.balance FROM main.accounts AS r WHERE r.tenant IS OLD.tenant AND r.name IS OLD.name AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_seen_accounts AS s WHERE s.tenant IS OLD.tenant AND s.name IS OLD.name);INSERT INTO _vault_seen_accounts SELECT OLD.tenant, OLD.name WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_seen_accounts AS s WHERE s.tenant IS OLD.tenant AND s.name IS OLD.name);INSERT INTO _vault_before_accounts SELECT r.tenant, r.name, r.balance FROM main.accounts AS r WHERE r.tenant IS NEW.tenant AND r.name IS NEW.name AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_seen_accounts AS s WHERE s.tenant IS NEW.tenant AND s.name IS NEW.name);INSERT INTO _vault_seen_accounts SELECT NEW.tenant, NEW.name WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_seen_accounts AS s WHERE s.tenant IS NEW.tenant AND s.name IS NEW.name);
                        INSERT INTO _vault_before_accounts
                        SELECT r.tenant, r.name, r.balance
                        FROM main.accounts AS r
                        WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.accounts AS v
                            WHERE v.rowid=NEW.rowid AND v.tenant IS r.tenant AND v.name IS r.name) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_seen_accounts AS s WHERE s.tenant IS r.tenant AND s.name IS r.name)
                    ;
                        INSERT INTO _vault_seen_accounts
                        SELECT r.tenant, r.name
                        FROM main.accounts AS r
                        WHERE r.rowid=NEW.rowid AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_seen_accounts AS s WHERE s.tenant IS r.tenant AND s.name IS r.name)
                    ;
                    END

CREATE TEMP TRIGGER _vault_accounts_DELETE
                    BEFORE DELETE ON main.accounts BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO _vault_before_accounts SELECT r.tenant, r.name, r.balance FROM main.accounts AS r WHERE r.tenant IS OLD.tenant AND r.name IS OLD.name AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_seen_accounts AS s WHERE s.tenant IS OLD.tenant AND s.name IS OLD.name);INSERT INTO _vault_seen_accounts SELECT OLD.tenant, OLD.name WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_seen_accounts AS s WHERE s.tenant IS OLD.tenant AND s.name IS OLD.name);
                    END
INSERT INTO _vault_before_accounts SELECT tenant, name, balance FROM main.accounts WHERE tenant IS 'one' AND name IS 'a'
INSERT INTO _vault_before_accounts SELECT tenant, name, balance FROM main.accounts WHERE tenant IS 'one' AND name IS 'b'

WITH actual AS (
                    SELECT tenant, name, balance, typeof(tenant), typeof(name), typeof(balance), count(*) AS n FROM main.accounts AS r
                    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _vault_seen_accounts AS s WHERE s.tenant IS r.tenant AND s.name IS r.name)
                    GROUP BY tenant, name, balance, typeof(tenant), typeof(name), typeof(balance)
                ), expected AS (
                    SELECT tenant, name, balance, typeof(tenant), typeof(name), typeof(balance), count(*) AS n FROM _vault_before_accounts
                    GROUP BY tenant, name, balance, typeof(tenant), typeof(name), typeof(balance)
                )
                SELECT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM actual EXCEPT SELECT * FROM expected)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT * FROM expected EXCEPT SELECT * FROM actual)
                    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM main.accounts) !=
                       (SELECT expected FROM _vault_count_accounts)
